name: Minamo
description: Kamigawa's foremost school of magic for human wizards, built on cliffs over the river and falls.

description_citations.text: "Yumegawa River". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu assaults Minamo, defeats Keiga, destroys the Academy and summons the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
timeline.quote: destroyed the Academy, and killed almost everyone inside

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu nearly kills Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and Toshi stabs the other.
timeline.quote: Toshi used Hidetsugu's momentary distraction and stabbed his remaining eye.

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi tears the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos in two, and Hidetsugu asks Toshi to transport him to the oni's honden.
timeline.quote: the oni overlord was almost effortlessly torn in two by O-Kagachi

citation.text: "Hidetsugu", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Jukai discover overlapping realms and, with the Imperials and Minamo, build merge gates around the rifts.
timeline.quote: Through their combined effort, the mortals built gates around every new rift

citation.text: "Kamigawa", section "The Era of Enlightenment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Minamo, Hidetsugu defeats Kiku bloodlessly; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and the tile breaks, so the curse reclaims her.
timeline.quote: In the fall, the tile was broken and the curse claimed her again.

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi stops Kiku from killing Hidetsugu, invoking the hyozan curse on herself, then blinds the ogre.
timeline.quote: thus invoking the hyozan curse upon herself

citation.text: "Kiku", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko and her party are at Minamo during Hidetsugu's attack and Toshi saves them.
timeline.quote: Once again, Toshi Umezawa saved her and her friends.

citation.text: "Michiko Konda", section "Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the Kami War begins, the five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo; Pipe argues for non-interference.
timeline.quote: Pipe argued for non-interference

citation.text: "Pipe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scale calls the scout a fool and accuses Pipe of manipulation; the kirin disperse and Pipe vanishes in flame.
timeline.quote: Pipe then disappeared in a blistering hot wave of flame and smoke

citation.text: "Pipe", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the Kami War began, the five kirin met in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo, as they do every 1,000 years.
timeline.quote: As the Kami War began, the five kirin met up as they do every 1,000 years.

citation.text: "Silverbeard", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scale mocked Silverbeard's story, but Silverbeard petitioned Scale to remember the time before the Kami War and still had hope for him.
timeline.quote: In the end, as the group was splitting he still had hope for Scale.

citation.text: "Silverbeard", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo as the Kami War begins.
timeline.quote: As the Kami War began, the five kirin met up as they do every 1,000 years.

citation.text: "Thorn (kirin)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thorn argues that kami and mortals are part of the same whole.
timeline.quote: Thorn argued that both Kami and mortals were a part of the rhythm of nature and were a part of the same whole.

citation.text: "Thorn (kirin)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scale argues against Thorn, who is not swayed.
timeline.quote: Though, Thorn would not be swayed believing he has seen the good in mortals.

citation.text: "Thorn (kirin)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Thorn is the last to leave the teahouse.
timeline.quote: Thorn was the last to leave the teahouse

citation.text: "Thorn (kirin)", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu chokes Toshi and Kiku; Marrow-Gnawer stabs his eye and invokes the oath's wrath.
timeline.quote: Marrow-Gnawer managed to stab the ogre's eye, freeing Toshi and Kiku but invoking the wrath of the oath upon himself.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi stabs Hidetsugu through the remaining eye; the All-Consuming and O-Kagachi clash and Hidetsugu is changed.
timeline.quote: Hidetsugu prevailed in the end, but Toshi used his victory gesture to stab him through the remaining eye from a shadow cast by Kiku's body.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi ends Marrow-Gnawer's suffering with an axe.
timeline.quote: The ronin was, however, unable to save Marrow-Gnawer from the curse and so ended the nezumi's suffering with an axe.

citation.text: "Toshiro Umezawa", section "The Kami War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Michiko speaks with Mochi at Minamo, learning what her father took was a daughter of O-Kagachi, as Toshi learns the soratami plan to conquer Kamigawa and Hidetsugu attacks Minamo.
timeline.quote: Then suddenly the academy is rocked as Hidetsugu attacks.

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi freezes Mochi and drops the Taken One at his feet, hoping Konda, O-Kagachi and Hidetsugu will fight over it, then teleports Michiko's party back to Jukai.
timeline.quote: Back at Minamo he freezes Mochi with his ice powers and drops the Taken One at his feet

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ogres and oni sweep through Minamo while scrollkeepers hold their posts.
timeline.quote: not even when the ogres and their oni masters swept through Minamo.

citation.text: Minamo Scrollkeeper (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Minamo is abandoned and young students are thrust into the war.
timeline.quote: When Minamo was abandoned, its younger students found themselves thrust into a war beyond their skill with talents beyond their control.

citation.text: Oppressive Will (Saviors of Kamigawa, 2005), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Toshi finds the oni eating Minamo's library and meets Hidetsugu, who wants his full commitment to the Hyozan Reckoners; Toshi refuses and they become enemies.
timeline.quote: knowing they are becoming enemies

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Toshi uses Night's Reach's powers to chase off the Oni of Chaos at Minamo, drawing Hidetsugu's ire as Konda's ghost army attacks.
timeline.quote: Luckily at that moment Konda and his ghost army attack Minamo

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu reveals the oath kills any who kill without drawing blood and chokes Kiku and Toshi; Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu in the eyes, bringing the oath's wrath on himself.
timeline.quote: he saves Toshi and Kiku by stabbing Hidetsugu in the eyes

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi appears; the Oni of Chaos flees, breaking Hidetsugu's spirit, and Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer.
timeline.quote: Toshi mercy kills Marrow-Gnawer

citation.text: "Guardian: Saviors of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The scrollkeepers of Minamo stay at the doors of the Great Library as ogres and oni masters sweep through.
timeline.quote: The scrollkeepers never stepped an inch away from the doors of the Great Library

citation.text: Minamo Scrollkeeper (Conspiracy, 2014), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu attacks Minamo and summons the All-Consuming, which feeds on the academics and their knowledge.
timeline.quote: The oni fed on the living and dead academics

citation.text: "All-Consuming Oni of Chaos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The All-Consuming tries to claim That Which Was Taken but is repelled and banished by Toshi.
timeline.quote: was repelled by the disk itself and then banished from the room by Toshi

citation.text: "All-Consuming Oni of Chaos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: O-Kagachi tears the All-Consuming in half; it flees and disappears.
timeline.quote: O-Kagachi almost effortlessly tore him in half and swallowed the torn part

citation.text: "All-Consuming Oni of Chaos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: As the Kami War begins, the five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo.
timeline.quote: the five kirin met up as they do every 1,000 years

citation.text: "Dew", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dew says he sees mortals as vessels and beings of light and wonder; the others call it madness.
timeline.quote: Dew responded that he speaks of dreams

citation.text: "Dew", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Dew recounts walking in mortals' dreams, including those of Meloku, Ishi-Ishi and Snow Fur.
timeline.quote: Dew danced among its clouds

citation.text: "Dew", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scale charges off and the kirin leave the meeting; Dew vanishes unnoticed.
timeline.quote: Dew disappeared without a word or the others noticing

citation.text: "Dew", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Minamo Marrow-Gnawer stabs Hidetsugu's eye, saving Kiku and Toshi but invoking the hyozan curse; Toshi ends his suffering with Kiku's ax.
timeline.quote: Toshi granted Marrow-Gnawer the last mercy of ending his suffering with Kiku's ax.

citation.text: "Marrow-Gnawer", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Jukai, Imperials and Minamo collaborate to develop merge gates around every rift.
timeline.quote: the mortals built gates around every new rift

citation.text: "Merge gate", section "The Era of Enlightenment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the outbreak of the Kami War Minamo becomes a frontline as kami emerge from the Falls.
timeline.quote: At the outbreak of the war, Minamo became a frontline

citation.text: "Minamo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Choryu kills Kobo, apprentice of Hidetsugu.
timeline.quote: made a grave mistake when he killed Kobo

citation.text: "Minamo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hidetsugu attacks Minamo, defeats Keiga, destroys the academy and decapitates Hisoka.
timeline.quote: defeated the guardian dragon Keiga , and destroyed the academy

citation.text: "Minamo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: What remained of the academy is destroyed in the battle between O-Kagachi and the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos.
timeline.quote: Whatever was left of the Academy was further destroyed in the battle between O-Kagachi and the All-Consuming Oni of Chaos .

citation.text: "Minamo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the war Minamo is rebuilt, but later declines and is replaced by Otawara.
timeline.quote: After the war, the Minamo School was rebuilt

citation.text: "Minamo", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The five kirin met in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo as the Kami War began, to discuss whether to be for or against mortals.
timeline.quote: As the Kami War began, the five kirin met up as they do every 1,000 years.

citation.text: "Scale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scale scorned the stories told by Silverbeard, Thorn, Pipe and Dew.
timeline.quote: Scale just called him a greedy fool and that Pipe's standards were too low.

citation.text: "Scale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scale told how he spread plague by inhabiting mortals who then died, and left the teahouse.
timeline.quote: Scale bowed deeply, then stepped out the door of the teahouse.

citation.text: "Scale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: he was also an agent of Minamo and its soratami masters

citation.text: "Choryu". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.note: Hidetsugu attacks the academy seeking vengeance for Kobo.
relations.quote: to raze the Minamo academy to the ground

citation.text: "Heretic: Betrayers of Kamigawa", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: they collaborated with the Imperials and Minamo to develop what would later be known as merge gates

citation.text: "Merge gate", section "The Era of Enlightenment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Minamo is led by the Soratami

citation.text: "Minamo", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Minamo Academy was guarded by Keiga

citation.text: "Minamo", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
